about_heading: One dentist, routine care and cosmetic work
about_body:
Circle C Dental is Dr. Blake Mulgrew's practice in suburban Austin, covering general dentistry and cosmetic treatment for people who live nearby.

Everyday care and cosmetic work are handled by the same dentist, so a checkup, a repair and a change to how your smile looks are part of one conversation rather than a set of referrals.

services.name: General dentistry
services.blurb: Checkups, cleanings and everyday treatment for adults and children in the neighborhood.

services.name: Cosmetic dentistry
services.blurb: Treatment focused on the appearance of your teeth, discussed before anything starts.

services.name: New patient visits
services.blurb: A first appointment with time to look properly and explain what you actually need.

services.name: Smile consultations
services.blurb: A sit-down about what you would change, with the options and costs set out plainly.

why_this_angle: The record is thin beyond a general and cosmetic specialty, so I leaned on the suburban Austin, owner-dentist positioning in city and role and kept every claim to what a one-dentist practice can honestly say.
